_comment: Starter template for a new dataset. Copy this file to <your_dataset_name>.json, fill in the fields below, and run: python3 code/run_autodelphirf.py --config config/datasets/<your_dataset_name>.json --diagnosis-only  first, to check the input schema before running the full replay. Remove every _comment key (they are not recognized fields; only present here as guidance) before using the file.
name: your_dataset_name
_input_columns_comment: input_columns is only needed if your prepared triangle's column names differ from the canonical names in config/prepared_triangle_schema.json. Map canonical name -> your source column name below; omit any pair that already matches (the defaults from prepared_triangle_schema.json apply automatically).
_comparator_comment: Leave comparator_file null unless you have an externally computed method to import -- see config/comparator_file_schema.json and config/comparator_file_template.csv for the contract.
